name: Meditation & mindfulness
route: No live app route; source-only mindfulness surface.
annotation: HIFI-54 · no live route (source-only mindfulness surface) · dark shell (#0A0A0F) + top-center amber radial glow (rgba(255,94,0,.18)) + 3-4% grain. CIAInsightCard (glow-cia purple synthesis, steady) is the screen's one glowing, dominant focal moment; SegmentedTabs and the two-row PracticeListCard form a quiet solid-surface operational layer beneath it; StreakCard, KPIRow, active session, and post-session feedback continue the same no-glow dense-data treatment below. Practice minutes and streak ship real (ChipProvenance 'app log'), low-confidence, or honest-null — never a fabricated streak.

modules.build: iOS status bar, dark mode, light icons over warm shell #0A0A0F + top-center amber radial glow (rgba(255,94,0,.18)) + 3-4% grain. Fixed 44px, no copy.

Transparent over atmosphere, glass-pill backing on scroll. Left: 44px back chevron. Center: 'Meditation' (H2). Right: domain stat badge 'Mental 4' (Mental domain score, 0-99 scale, right-aligned per screen-19 Domain Stat Score header pattern). 44px targets.

Purple-tinted glass, r28, single steady purple glow (glow-cia; the screen's only glow). Copy: 'Your stress is elevated. A 5-minute body scan can shift your *baseline*.' ('baseline' in Newsreader Medium Italic — the screen's one emphasis word). Ghost pill '[ ask CIA ]'.

Scroll-chip variant for practice filters, 44px touch targets. Tabs: [ all ] [ meditation ] [ quick ] [ move ]. Active tab (default 'all'): orange fill/border #FF5E00. Inactive: white-8% border, muted text.

Solid surface #211008, r24, no glow (dense-data rule). SectionHeader 'Practices' above two rows. Row 1: icon, title 'Body scan meditation', duration '10 min', benefit 'Reduces tension', context chip 'before sleep'. Row 2: icon, title 'Deep breathing', duration '3 min', benefit 'Anchors focus', context chip 'anytime'. Tap scales .98/150ms, opens full session sheet.

Solid surface #211008, r24, no glow (dense-data rule). Copy 'mindfulness streak'. Seven-day strip (O O O O O O O) + '12 days'. Heatmap blocks (# # # # # # #) + 'last 4 weeks'. ChipProvenance 'app log' (exact local count, never estimated).

Shared solid metric row, r20, no glow (dense-data rule). Three metrics: '24 sess.' / '145 min.' / 'longest 12'. ChipProvenance 'app log' on minutes only, per Data Honesty; the other two carry no honesty tier defined in source.

belowFold: ActiveSessionSheet (full variant, reached by tapping a practice row): breathing visual (VoiceMicGlow repurposed, decorative) scales continuously on an 8s loop while ProgressRing sweeps the timer; pause control; duration selector. Double tap toggles pause. Reduced motion freezes the breathing loop at its current state; the session container announces remaining time and phase to screen readers.

PostSessionFeedbackSheet (half variant): asks for rating and note; rating circles fill left-to-right; saving emits one light haptic. Success: 250ms green flash, updates streak/KPI values, dismisses sheet. Disabled: premium-only feedback analysis and advanced CIA recommendations blur behind PaywallLock with a single orange CTA.
Error (Practice list): ErrorState with retry; cached practices remain tappable when safe to do so.
Empty: library stays fully populated; CIA card recommends the 3-minute breathing exercise. Streak/heatmap honest-null reads '0 days' with muted dots and a first-session CTA.
trustControls: Practice minutes honesty triple — real: orange sparkline + ChipProvenance 'app log'; low-confidence: dashed tail + 'estimated · low confidence'; honest-null: empty chart frame + 'Not enough data yet - 3 more days for a trend.'

Current streak honesty triple — real: '12 day streak' + heatmap blocks + ChipProvenance 'app log' (streaks are exact local counts, never estimated); honest-null: '0 days' with muted dots and a first-session CTA.
Consistency heatmap — real: filled intensity squares built from completed sessions; source defines no separate low-confidence or honest-null variant beyond the streak card's own null state.
Privacy-first language maintained; SafetyResourceCard reachable for journal, mood, stress, sleep, energy, voice, and wellbeing-adjacent moments.
Source chips include category, source, scope, freshness, retention, export, revoke, and delete.
